item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make your professional photo because your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits. I tried twice and neither attempt went through, so nothing was made and no credits were used.

1. **Headshot tool:** this turns a selfie into a professional headshot. It costs 50 credits, and the account refused it.
2. **Image edit:** I asked for the same person in a charcoal suit and white shirt, with a plain gray studio background and soft lighting. This used the cheapest free-plan setting (about 5 credits at 640px), and the account refused it too. That means the balance is probably under 5 credits.

**To go ahead:**
- Add credits or wait for your free credits to refill, then tell me and I'll run it again. With 50 or more credits, the headshot tool should give the most polished result. With at least 5, I can do the cheaper edit.
- You can also upgrade your plan. That would allow higher resolutions and better models.
